# Decision 0017: Generated bytes use definite storage and scoped observation

Status: accepted initial milestone

Date: 2026-08-23

## Context

Profile 1 represents a byte value as the raw octets inside its enclosing field
extent. A constructing decoder needs definite caller-owned Ada storage, while
IPC observation should be able to lend the already validated payload without
copying or weakening the payload lease lifetime.

## Decision

The initial bytes binding names:

- a component whose type is compatible with
  `Ada.Streams.Stream_Element_Array`/`Flyology_Wire.Octet_Array`;
- a separate `Interfaces.Unsigned_64` logical-length component;
- the schema-selected construction lower bound and maximum capacity; and
- an explicit Boolean opt-in to generated borrowed observation.

Only required byte fields are accepted in this slice. The Ada legality gate
checks that the named array component can be passed directly to the wire
octet primitives. Generated compile-time checks require capacity at least the
schema maximum and an exact construction lower bound. A distinct array type,
undersized array, wrong lower bound, or incompatible length component fails
generation or Ada compilation rather than being converted or overlaid.

Measure and encode observe only the logical prefix. Encode preflights the
complete value and destination before copying. Decode initializes a bounded
candidate, validates the complete field extent, copies into its prefix, records
the logical length, leaves unused capacity at the generated initialization
value, and publishes the candidate only after every required field succeeds.

When borrowed observation is requested, the initial generator accepts an
exact-schema record containing only required scalar and byte fields, with all
byte fields opted in. It emits `Validate_And_Visit` with statically bound
callbacks. A first pass validates the complete payload and invokes no
application code. A second bounded pass copies scalars into callback arguments
and lends byte extents directly from the input through `Visit_Extent`.
Application callback exceptions propagate. The caller must keep the input
stable through normal return or exception unwinding, as required by decision
0005.

Approved compatibility writers are not yet accepted by this generated visitor
slice. Generation fails if both capabilities are requested, rather than
silently applying exact-schema visitor behavior to a compatible writer.

## Consequences

- Ordinary decode remains a construction contract and necessarily copies into
  application-owned definite storage.
- Borrowed observation performs no byte-payload copy and returns no view,
  access value, address, or retainable offset object.
- Empty required byte values remain present and emit a zero-length field,
  unlike absent optional or omitted defaulted fields.
- Optional/defaulted bytes, text validation, sequences containing bytes, and
  compatible-writer visitors require later reviewed lowering rules.
